# Endcap Reset — Spring 2026

- **Goal / definition of done:** reset all main-aisle endcaps to the **Spring** planogram package — camp/hike
  season features, spring apparel, hydration.
- **Owner:** [Kyle Bennett](../people/kyle-bennett.md) (former AM, Merchandising) — this was **his last
  completed project** before he left.
- **Status:** **COMPLETE** — set on schedule in **March 2026**, passed the merchandising compliance check.
  > ⚠️ Distinct from the [Endcap Reset — **Summer**](../projects/endcap-reset-summer.md), which is the current,
  > still-open one. This Spring reset is done and closed.
- **Notes:** clean execution; used as the template for how Summer should run. Co-op footwear feature performed
  well, which is why Marc wants it repeated for Summer.
